title.value: An Act to Amend the Laws Relating to the Prevention of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances Pollution
title.provenance: An Act to Amend the Laws Relating to the Prevention of Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances Pollution

status.provenance: Be it enacted by the People of the State of Maine as follows

pfas_definition.provenance: F. "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Effective Except as provided pursuant to paragraph F or G, effective January 1, 2023, a person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this State a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS.

who.provenance: a person may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale

action.provenance: may not sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale

products.provenance: a carpet or rug that contains intentionally added PFAS

exceptions.provenance: does not apply to the sale, offer for sale or resale distribution for sale of a used any carpet or rug in used condition

currently_unavoidable.provenance: Products in which the use of PFAS is a currently unavoidable use as determined by the department may be exempted by the department by rule.
